source_finding.finding: GRID10 plan_sha256 is still produced with typed_entry_canonical_v1.encode_canonical, i.e. the legacy ENTITYOS_HCU_ENTRY_CBOR_RFC8949_SUBSET/v1 encoder, while current main selects RFC8785_JCS_IJSON/v1 for the converged Entry+HCU causal identity path.

why_material: GRID10 consumes admitted Entry and the single HCU RouteDecision and emits a durable plan identity used to bind causal execution planning.
Migrating Entry, router and inference receipt to JCS while leaving GridPlan on CBOR would reintroduce mixed active identity semantics immediately downstream of the migrated route.
Changing GridPlan alone now would be premature and would temporarily increase mixed-schema surface; migration must be coordinated and versioned end to end.
Historical GridPlan hashes must retain their original encoder scope and must not be silently rehashed or reinterpreted.
required_reentry: include ENTITYOS_HCU_GRID_PLAN identity in the same versioned RFC8785 migration envelope as new Entry event/admission, router policy/EngineAdmission/route and inference receipt identities
bind canonicalization schema/version into the new GridPlan identity
reject mixed, unknown and downgrade canonicalization versions across Entry -> Route -> GridPlan -> Inference boundaries
preserve historical CBOR/Python-local hashes at original schema/source scope
run exact-current combined Entry+route+GridPlan+inference+canonicalizer regression on an actually-started authorized isolated executor before runtime promotion
counterhypothesis: GridPlan may keep a separate deterministic CBOR identity because it is only a scheduler artifact.
counterhypothesis_status: REJECT_FOR_CURRENT_SINGLE_CAUSAL_PATH_UNLESS_GRIDPLAN_IS_EXPLICITLY_NONCAUSAL_AND_NEVER_USED_AS_EXECUTION_OR_RECEIPT_IDENTITY; current source exposes plan_sha256 as execution-plan identity, so separate active canonicalization would preserve a schema fork.

coordination.reason: Do not migrate GRID10 alone before the upstream Entry/router/inference versioned migration; record the dependency so the retained lane changes once rather than creating another temporary hash authority.
coordination.readme_reason: Current README already names single-canonicalization convergence and combined GRID10 exact execution as frontier; this receipt narrows the migration obligation to include GridPlan identity.

unusual_experiment_accounting.note: Source inspection/re-entry only. No additional unusual experiment is claimed.

next_exact_gate: Perform one coordinated versioned RFC8785 migration across Entry event/admission -> router policy/EngineAdmission/route -> GridPlan -> inference receipt, then execute the exact combined path in an authorized isolated executor with mixed/unknown/downgrade-schema falsifiers and loader-consumed-byte lease binding.
